people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: Elijah said, “As Yahweh of Armies lives, before whom I stand, I will surely show myself to him today.”
translations.bsb: Then Elijah said, “As surely as the LORD of Hosts lives, before whom I stand, I will present myself to Ahab today.”
translations.kjv: And Elijah said, As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.
translations.asv: And Elijah said, As Jehovah of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely show myself unto him to-day.
